purpose: Teach: ランナー/協奏曲/イエロー/ベリー/タラ/兎/フェリー/ランニング

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、私、リレーのランナー、結構、速かったんだよな、ばあさん。
lines.en: Back when I was young, I was a pretty fast relay runner, you know.
lines.style: Soft, remembering voice. Gentle lift on the memory. Slow, unhurried pace. Trailing fondly into the shared understanding with his wife.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。私たち、若い頃、ピアノ協奏曲、コンサート、行ったわね。
lines.en: Yes, I remember. We went to that piano concerto together when we were young.
lines.style: Warm, present in the memory. Soft voice, confirming gently. A small smile in the tone. Reaches across time to meet him there.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 最近の若い人、イエローのシャツ、流行ってるよな、お洒落だな。
lines.en: These days the young people wear those yellow shirts — they're quite stylish, aren't they.
lines.style: Observing, gentle shift to the present. Light, almost amused tone. The kind of noticing an elderly person does — genuinely interested, not critical.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 昔、田舎で、野生のベリー、よく摘んで、ジャムにしたわよ。
lines.en: When we were in the countryside long ago, we used to pick wild berries all the time and make jam.
lines.style: Voice drifts backward into the countryside. Unhurried, tangible — she can almost smell it. Quiet satisfaction. The specific joy of remembered hands at work.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: タラの干物、年末、お歳暮で、よくいただいたな、覚えてる?
lines.en: Remember how we used to get dried cod as year-end gifts? I still remember receiving those.
lines.style: Gentle inquiry wrapped in certainty. A slight lift on the memory of the gift itself. Asking her to confirm what he already knows they both remember.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 孫が、兎、飼いたいって、お父さんに、頼んでいたわよ、先週。
lines.en: Our grandson was asking his father if he could keep a rabbit — just last week, he was.
lines.style: Soft, present-tense shift. Mild amusement in the tone. She's watching the grandchild's want, not lost in the past. Brief and observant.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 瀬戸内海のフェリー、新婚旅行で、乗ったよな、二人で、ばあさん。
lines.en: We took the ferry across the Seto Inland Sea for our honeymoon, didn't we? Just the two of us.
lines.style: Voice settles into deep memory, intimate. Slow, deliberate. A question that isn't really a question — he's pulling her back to that specific moment. Quiet wonder at the permanence of it.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃のあなた、朝のランニング、毎日、続けていたわよね、本当に。
lines.en: You really did run every single morning when you were young — you were so dedicated about it.
lines.style: Admiring, gentle. Confirming something true about him she's watched all these years. Quiet strength beneath the tenderness. Slow, deliberate — she's seeing him clearly.
